title: What Hogan taught
summary: Hogan taught Hanon exercises and two-part inventions to a small class.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Learning your horn: teachers, lessons and fees

blocks.x: Yeah, Professor Hogan, did he teach a wide variety of music or did he just?

Well I know that one time he had three of us, he had his niece, he had another guy, myself, we had a class, we all were like on the same category, playing music, we were all about the same level. He was playing Hanan exercises and he had us playing, I got one or two part inventions with him. Yeah. That type of thing. And Kool-Aye. And those type of things that I played with him. I remember that song, they used a lot of time for cartoons. You know, it starts off very slowly. I have to start remembering names man, because I'm bad at remembering names. That was one of the classical tunes that I learned under Professor Hogan. But years have passed and I don't even play it anymore. But I have the books at home that I can always go back and check. But if I need to I can always ask Roger. Roger can show me and bring me up to date on a lot of stuff.
